reporting: Two rule-grounded checks and six qualitative cases; S055 has no unique normative action.

K_RAW.K1: Skills-currency training in manual stabilised mode.
K_RAW.K2: Proposed geofence is 40 m high with a 300 m radius.
K_RAW.K3: The standard setting has no flight-specific suitability assessment.

K_RAG.E01: Authorization maxima are not a recommended setting.
K_RAG.E02: The safety material says appropriate but supplies no selection criteria.
K_RAG.E03: No applicable geofence-crossing checklist or procedure is supplied.

M.M2: Applicable response procedure for a geofence crossing.

H: Later mode changes, loss of control, impact, damage, causal analysis, and corrective actions.

K_RAW.K1: The formation has not begun transition to the show area.
K_RAW.K3: Eighty-five aircraft show errors and all identifiable errors are position deviations.

K_RAG.E02: Small separations depend on positioning and there is no independent onboard collision avoidance.
K_RAG.E03: The wind display does not issue an automatic exceedance warning.

case_keys.R: R1: compare the 9.9 m/s current estimate with the supplied 8 m/s published limit.
case_keys.anchor_check: A response that says the supplied wind limit is not exceeded conflicts with R1. This check does not convert the eight-case probe into an accuracy analysis.
H: Collisions, geofence crossings, losses of contact, water impacts, later analysis, and corrective actions.

K_RAW.K1: Night filming at a festival attended by several thousand people.
K_RAW.K2: The intended launch point is absent from the filed operating sites.

K_RAG.E01: The launch point is outside the sites listed in the night-flight filing.
K_RAG.E02: The applicable S-3 operation does not permit flight over third parties.
K_RAG.E03: Night permission requires at least 30 m horizontal separation from uninvolved people.

case_keys.R: R1: the current launch point is not included in the filed sites. E02 and E03 govern review of any revised operation but are not assumed breached by an unprovided flight path.
case_keys.anchor_check: Do not treat an actual later path or measured separation as available evidence.
H: Actual flight path and distances measured from later video.
Battery-alert account, impact, injuries, damage, missing logs, testing, and causal analysis.

K_RAW.K1: Command-unit power is not restored and the UPS has less than six minutes remaining.
K_RAW.K2: The crew cannot issue effective commands.
K_RAW.K3: The aircraft remains visible to ATC and holds while the communications heartbeat is present.

K_RAG.E01: Backup-power state and unsuccessful generator connection.
K_RAG.E03: Effect of the communications heartbeat on the aircraft state.

M.M1: A prespecified emergency-notification trigger or procedure.

H: Later fault diagnosis, borrowed UPS, restored control, landing, and corrective actions.

K_RAW.K1: Navigation and command control are lost and the geofence has not constrained the aircraft.
K_RAW.K3: Tracking places the aircraft over an unpopulated area and flight termination is available.

K_RAG.E01: The failed navigation, control, geofence, and recovery state.
K_RAG.E02: Current location over an unpopulated area.
K_RAG.E03: Termination is available but no prespecified trigger is supplied.

M.M1: The applicable flight-termination trigger or procedure.

H: Vertical descent, impact, total loss, technical cause, and later modifications.

K_RAW.K1: Urgent public-safety pursuit about 2.6 NM from a Class D airport.
K_RAW.K2: The pilot reports submitting through an application.
K_RAW.K3: No approval message, authorization number, or approved time window is in the decision record.

K_RAG.E02: Eligibility for automatic approval up to 100 ft does not establish approval of this request.
K_RAG.E03: No verifiable approval record is supplied.

M.M1: A verifiable approval record for the current operation.
M.M2: Any applicable alternative emergency authorization and evidence that it was obtained.

H: Post-flight discovery that the request was not processed, later classification, observer accounts, and absence of conflicts.

K_RAW.K1: A new special-category proposal relies on a parachute for ground-risk reduction.
K_RAW.K2: The dossier cites a nominal 80 J value.
K_RAW.K3: No system-specific evidence is supplied for descent energy, attachment integrity, or warning audibility.

K_RAG.E01: A historical official investigation found impact energy substantially above 80 J.
K_RAG.E02: Historical connection-line and warning-audibility failures are not observations of the new system.
K_RAG.E03: Special-category review uses SORA and applicable M2 compliance material.

H: Any later disposition or later submissions for the constructed proposal.
The final implementation status of the historical recommendation.

K_RAW.K1: UAS continue to monitor the original barrier lake.
K_RAW.K2: A second blockage and barrier lake are forming 2.8 km downstream.
K_RAW.K3: The proposal moves all reconnaissance UAS and stops monitoring the original site while key capacity and risk information is absent.

K_RAG.E01: The original site remains under active monitoring.
K_RAG.E02: The second monitoring demand is confirmed and developing.
K_RAG.E03: Fleet capacity, endurance, coverage, communications, comparative risk, and concurrent-monitoring feasibility are not supplied.

M.M1: Reconnaissance capacity, endurance, coverage, and communications.
M.M2: Comparative risk and feasibility of concurrent monitoring.

H: Later expert assessment and movement of nearby rescuers.
Later water conditions, damage, and response effects.
